storage: Wrap unwashed in a damp paper towel inside a bag in the fridge; or stand roots-down in a glass of water.
looksLike: A bunch of long hollow green leaves above a small white bulb with roots; mild oniony taste.
howToPick: Crisp, deep-green upright leaves and firm white bulbs. Avoid slimy, yellowing or wilted tops.
shelfLife: About 5 to 7 days in the fridge (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Chives or the green tops of a regular onion's young plant

usedIn.raw: 10 g per serving (1 stalk, whites and greens)
